cues: A progressive wave carries energy, not matter, and can be transverse or longitudinal.
v equals f lambda, and the medium fixes v.
The travelling wave is y equals a sine, omega t minus k x. Phase difference is two pi over lambda times the path difference, and particle velocity peaks at a omega.
Two equal waves travelling in opposite directions make a stationary wave, two a cos k x sine omega t, with nodes half a wavelength apart, and a node a quarter wavelength from each antinode.
text: Let us recap. A progressive wave carries energy, not matter, and can be transverse or longitudinal. v equals f lambda, and the medium fixes v. The travelling wave is y equals a sine, omega t minus k x. Phase difference is two pi over lambda times the path difference, and particle velocity peaks at a omega. Two equal waves travelling in opposite directions make a stationary wave, two a cos k x sine omega t, with nodes half a wavelength apart, and a node a quarter wavelength from each antinode.
